journey.name: Create And Propose Subscription
journey.description:
Creator side. Builds a subscription from the Subscriptions overview and proposes it to a saved, linked contact, ending on the sent confirmation and the new row in the CREATED section. Requires the two linked Bitkit instances described in README.md.
iOS differs from the Android original in two places. The description field is a text editor rather than a text field, so `ui-automation type-text --element-ref` refuses it; tap the field and type with `ui-automation type-text --text` instead, or skip the description and take the More Info step of review-and-subscribe.xml as absent. The sent confirmation headline wraps as "Sent" over "Proposal" rather than reading on one line.

actions.action: Launch the E2E Bitkit app with Paykit UI enabled and the payer instance saved as a contact linked on receiver path "bitkit/wallet"
Open the drawer menu and tap Subscriptions
Verify the Subscriptions screen (id "SubscriptionsScreen") appears with the Overview tab (id "Tab-overview") selected
Verify the create sheet (id "CreateSubscription") appears with Choose Recipient disabled
Tap the amount pencil (id "SubscriptionEditAmount"), enter "5000" on the keypad, and tap Continue (id "SubscriptionAmountContinue")
Type "Journey Sub" into the subscription name field (id "SubscriptionName")
Type a short description into the description field (id "SubscriptionDescription"), so the payer's detail screen offers More Info later
Verify the frequency selector has "Monthly" selected (id "Tab-month")
Verify the recipient step lists the linked contact under CONTACTS and that Propose Subscription (id "SubscriptionPropose") is disabled
Tap the linked contact row and verify it shows the selected checkmark
Verify the sent confirmation (id "SubscriptionProposalSent") shows headline "Sent Proposal", the recipient contact, and the subscription name with 5,000 sats
Verify a row for "Journey Sub" appears in the CREATED section with subtitle "Proposal sent"
